name: house-t1-b-savanna
description: Daub House, the savanna look (ROADMAP 49.10d): the shipped Daub House drawn again as a veranda house: two storeys of packed mud in a grey acacia frame under one golden thatch hip with a pot on its ridge, a thatched veranda across the front, a painted band, the kitchen under a lower half-hip, a tall mud stack.
